_meta.title: Judges — key verses (King James Version, public domain)
_meta.description: Curated key verses from Judges (God's call and reassurance to Gideon). Ecosystem-generic 864zeros content. Each record carries the exact scripture plus an original plain-English rendering.
_meta.license: Public domain (KJV scripture); 'plain' renderings are original 864zeros writing
_meta.source: getbible.net v2 (KJV, book 7 Judges); verses verbatim, curly apostrophes normalized to straight
_meta.selection: key verses from the substantive chapters; the violent narrative cycles are largely omitted
_meta.renderings: text = the exact KJV verse; plain = original 864zeros plain-English 2026 rendering, faithful to the verse's meaning (~grade 6-8), authored not quoted.
_meta.note: getbible's KJV renders the divine name as 'the Lord'; text is verbatim KJV. No review gate — author is reviewer.

verses.text: And the angel of the Lord appeared unto him, and said unto him, The Lord is with thee, thou mighty man of valour.
verses.plain: The angel of the Lord appeared to him and said, 'The Lord is with you, mighty warrior.'

verses.text: And the Lord said unto him, Peace be unto thee; fear not: thou shalt not die.
verses.plain: But the Lord said to him, 'Peace! Do not be afraid. You are not going to die.'
